Callout.Name: Cattle Truck - Load Shift
Callout.Message: Cattle truck lost part of its load on a bend.
Callout.Advisory: Cattle on the road, driver on scene.

Script.Line: The load shifted on the bend and the gate came off.
They are on the road and there is traffic coming over the crest.
Nobody is hurt. The cattle are all over the carriageway.

Lines.Approach: They went over the side on the bend and they are all over the road.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
